title: BTC ETF flows hit $1.2B daily, breaking February record
summary: Net inflows into U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs reached $1.21B yesterday, breaking the prior record set in February 2024.

title: Ethereum Pectra upgrade locks in mainnet date for Q3
summary: Core developers signaled Pectra (EIP-7702 + 7251 + 6110 bundle) will activate on mainnet in early Q3 2026 after successful Holesky testing.

title: Solana network outage resolved after 124 minutes
summary: A consensus bug in Solana mainnet required a coordinated validator restart; block production resumed at 11:42 UTC after 124 minutes downtime.

title: SEC drops appeal in Ripple secondary-sales ruling
summary: The SEC withdrew its appeal of Judge Torres's 2023 ruling that XRP secondary sales did not constitute securities transactions.

title: Chainlink rolls out CCIP support for 8 new chains
summary: Chainlink expanded CCIP cross-chain messaging to Arbitrum Nova, Mantle, Linea, Scroll, and four more L2s, doubling supported chain count.

title: Whale moves 12,400 BTC out of Coinbase to cold storage
summary: On-chain analysts flagged 12,400 BTC ($848M) moving from Coinbase to a cold-storage cluster — typically a bullish accumulation signal.

title: Cardano governance votes pass first Plomin hard-fork agenda items
summary: Cardano's first Plomin governance vote concluded with 78% of stake-weighted approval, paving the way for the hard fork's parameter changes.

title: Polygon AggLayer mainnet beta launches with 6 chains
summary: Polygon's AggLayer cross-chain liquidity layer launched in mainnet beta, connecting 6 zk-rollups initially.

title: Memecoin mania cools; DOGE, SHIB, PEPE down double-digits
summary: Memecoin sector lost 14% over the past week as funds rotated to majors. DOGE -12%, SHIB -18%, PEPE -22%.

title: Fed minutes signal patience on rate cuts; risk assets retest
summary: April FOMC minutes showed a majority preferring to hold rates steady through summer, with one cut penciled in for September.
